# Cncf Pipy Reviewer

Review Pipy using its official documentation and repository in the Orchestration &amp; Management / Service Proxy category. Pipy is a programmable proxy for the cloud, edge and IoT. It&#39;s written in C++, which makes it extremely lightweight and fast. It&#39;s also fully programmable by using PipyJS, a tailored version from the standard JavaScript language.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
